meta.title: William Football Coaching — Duval County, FL
meta.description: Professional football coaching in Jacksonville, FL. Training sessions for youth and high school athletes.

about.name: Coach William
about.bio: My goal is to prepare my clients in all aspects of their sport and/or life.  I believe in being a teacher, rather than a coach.  My clients will learn the best techniques, discipline and how to have a competitive mindset.  Client's workouts will all be scientific based and tracked for the best results.

hero.headline: Duval County's Premier Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized football training that turns potential into performance.

testimonials.quote: Best investment we've made in our son's athletic career. Coach William is the real deal.
testimonials.name: Sandra K.

testimonials.quote: Coach William doesn't just coach the sport — he coaches the whole athlete. That made all the difference.
testimonials.name: DeShawn F.
